source_text: Provide viros potentes, timentes Deum; constitue tribunos. Non omnia Moyses solus; ordo in ecclesia. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Provide men powerful, fearing God; appoint tribunes. Not all-things Moses alone; order in church. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Provide able men who fear God; appoint them rulers of thousands >> Bible:Exodus 18:21]]. Moses cannot do all alone; the church needs order. Amen.
